info.title: MyEfVibe — EF Core LINQ REPL
info.description: Interactive global .NET tool (efvibe) to run LINQ against an external project's EF Core DbContext with most relational providers (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle, MySQL, Firebird, and more), plus SQL, query plans, and session analytics.

options.name: --workspace
options.description:
Session directory for exports and artifacts.
Default: ~/.efvibe or %APPDATA%/efvibe.

options.name: --project
options.description:
EF Core project to build (.csproj with the
DbContext).

options.name: --startup-project
options.description:
Startup project for configuration (user secrets,
appsettings).

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name or fully qualified name.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Connection string for manual DbContextOptions
construction.

options.name: --expression
options.description: Run a single expression and exit (non-interactive).

options.name: --dblog
options.description:
(Default: true) Enable EF database command logging
(default: on; toggle in REPL with :dblog).

options.name: --no-dblog
options.description: Disable EF database command logging.

options.name: --dblog-level
options.description:
Database log level: trace | debug | information |
warning | error | critical | none.

options.name: --dblog-verbose
options.description:
Show full EF diagnostic logs (default: sql-only
executed commands).

options.name: --about-json
options.description:
Write tool metadata as JSON to stdout and exit (no
workspace or DbContext required).

options.name: --tables-json
options.description:
Write DbSet names and entity types as JSON to stdout
and exit (no REPL).

options.name: --describe-json
options.description:
Write entity member schema as JSON for the given
DbSet or entity type name and exit (no REPL).

options.name: --dbinfo-json
options.description:
Write database and connection metadata as JSON to
stdout and exit (no REPL).

options.name: --completions-json
options.description:
Write db.* completion items for the given prefix
(e.g. db.Pro) and exit (no REPL).

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format for one-shot -e runs: text (default)
or json.

options.name: --no-banner
options.description:
Suppress workspace and build banners (recommended
with --format json).

options.name: --with-plan
options.description:
With -e --format json, include EXPLAIN / SHOWPLAN
for the evaluated SQL.

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Target framework moniker for building the workspace
project (e.g. net8.0).

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: expression
arguments.description: Optional one-shot expression when -e is omitted.
